# TIGGES

> Family and ventures hub for the Tigges family.

TIGGES gathers the Tigges family studios and ventures in one place.

- Art Leon: paintings, drawings, and studio work — https://leontigges.com/
- Art Barbara: paintings and works on paper — https://barbaratigges.com/
- Architecture: studio in Spain — https://tiggesarchitekt.ch/
- Music / DJ URBANT — https://djurbant.com/
- Set Radar: timed tracklists — https://setradar.ai/
- GTA VI.AI — https://gtavi.ai/

Site: https://tigg3s.com/
About: https://tigg3s.com/about.html
